app.name: Wusool Safe
app.betaBanner: Pilot version — do not rely on it alone for children's safety

auth.passwordHint: At least 8 characters; avoid common words and your name
auth.phoneHint: Used only to call you in an emergency; no code is sent to it
auth.passwordChanged: Password changed. Please sign in again.
auth.verifyEmailIntro: We sent a 6-digit code to your email. It is valid for 10 minutes.
auth.codeResent: A new code was sent to your email

push.title: Turn on notifications
push.why: Notifications are the only way we can reach you if a child is left on the vehicle. Without them you will not be alerted.
push.limits: Notifications can be delayed if the phone is off or in battery saver. Keep it charged and do not mute this app.
push.testSent: A test notification was sent. Check that it appeared on your phone.
push.denied: Notification permission was denied. Allow it in your browser or phone settings and try again.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support notifications. Use Chrome, Edge, or Safari after adding to the home screen.
push.iosInstallTitle: On iPhone, install the app first:
push.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari
push.iosStep3: Open the app from the home screen and come back to this page

driver.pushRequired: You cannot start a trip until notifications work on this device.
driver.tapRejected: One entry was not accepted. The list was refreshed.
driver.addStudent: Add a student from the organisation
driver.onboardBody: The trip cannot end while these children are recorded on board. Check the vehicle and record each one getting off.
driver.unresolvedBody: Mark each child as boarded or absent.
driver.confirmEmptyBody: Have you checked that the vehicle is completely empty, including the back seats?
driver.confirmEmpty: Yes, the vehicle is empty — end trip
driver.forceWarning: A critical alert will be sent immediately to guardians and the admin about {{count}} child(ren).
driver.forceConfirm: End trip and raise the alert
driver.reminderBody: {{count}} child(ren) recorded on board. End the trip once they got off.

guardian.noChildren: You have not added a child yet.
guardian.enablePush: Turn on notifications to hear about your children.
guardian.photoWhy: A clear face photo is required: the driver recognises your child by it. The transport provider sees it only after accepting the request.
guardian.privacyNotice: We use your child's name, photo and date of birth only to record boarding and getting off and to inform you. Location is recorded only at the moment the driver taps; there is no continuous tracking. You can request deletion in Settings.
guardian.consent: I agree to my child's data being processed for this purpose
guardian.submitChild: Add child and send the request

guardianBody.student_left_onboard: {{student}} is recorded on {{vehicle}} and was not recorded getting off after the trip ended.
guardianBody.trip_overdue: {{student}}'s trip on {{vehicle}} is overdue and has not ended.

alert.noActionNeeded: The admin and driver are handling it now. Nothing is needed from you.

reason.found_on_vehicle_and_alighted: Found on the vehicle and got off

admin.noOrg: You are not an admin of any organisation.
admin.createOrg: Register an organisation or independent driver
admin.pendingReview: Your organisation is waiting for platform review and is hidden from guardians until approved.
admin.needsReview: Schools and transport companies become visible to guardians after platform review.
admin.enrollmentPrivacy: Before approval you only see the name and school. The photo and date of birth appear after approval.
admin.unreachableIntro: These guardians might not receive alerts right now. Contact them to turn on notifications.
admin.allReachable: Every guardian has a working device.
admin.stopsOnePerLine: Stops in order, one per line
admin.assignIntro: Choose each student's stop on this route.

settings.muteRoutine: Mute routine boarding and getting-off notifications
settings.alertsNeverMuted: Critical alerts can never be muted.
settings.deleteWarning: Your account and personal data will be deleted, and photos of children with no other guardian. Trip and alert records are kept for safety.
